documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: In its Q1 FY27 earnings call, Uniparts India Limited reported a 27% year-on-year increase in revenue from operations to INR 347 crores, driven by robust performance in the construction equipment segment. EBITDA grew by 55% year-on-year to INR 90 crores, supported by favorable channel mix and operating leverage. The company maintained a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores and reported a trailing 12-month new business order book exceeding INR 225 crores. Management raised its outlook for FY27, expecting top-line growth to outperform FY26 by a couple of percentage points. Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64%.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q2 FY27 performance to be robust and in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to comfortably deliver EBITDA margins of over 20% for FY27.
guidance.quote: We, actually are confident that 20% plus is what we will deliver.

guidance.claim: Mexico operations are expected to contribute mid-single-digit million dollar revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 revenue performance to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects full-year FY27 revenue growth to be in line with FY26 growth levels.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The construction equipment segment performed well in Q1 FY27 due to technology investments in the U.S. and government infrastructure spending in Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment market conditions remain subdued, with 2026 expected to represent the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment in Western markets is seeing measured growth, though unit volumes are beginning to recover after three consecutive years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: In the Western market, small ag growth remains more measured.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket segment accounted for 12% of Q1 FY27 revenue and remained flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs in large agriculture have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket represented approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Aftermarket represents approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket demand skewing occurred due to tariff-driven price volatility, which management expects to normalise as tariffs have come down.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing. With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: North American construction equipment demand is expected to continue growing in FY27 with H2 performing better than H1.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for compact construction equipment in Europe has been a bright spot with early signs of recovery in Q4 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, the demand for compact equipment has been a bright spot and infrastructure-led spending supported by fiscal stimulus defense investment and energy transition projects is expected to provide a more stable demand environment throughout the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is poised for around 5% growth in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry volumes for large tractors in North America continue to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tractor industry demand remains stable subject to monsoon performance.
demand_outlook.quote: And coming to India, the tractor industry demand remains stable, although we have to see how it reacts to the monsoons.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts incurred capital expenditure of INR 12 crores in Q1 FY27 for capacity enhancement and productivity improvement.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the Ludhiana facility's finishing shop is progressing on schedule without customer supply disruption.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's regular capex requirement ranges between 2.5% and 3.5% of total revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: I think overall, if you see, even after having done that, today, our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts plans to maintain its capex in the range of 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex stood at INR 12 crores for Q4 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capex_expansion.claim: Rebuilding efforts are well underway at the fire-affected Ludhiana facility.
capex_expansion.quote: And in parallel, the rebuilding effort is well underway.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 90 crores, representing a 55% year-on-year and 10% sequential growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost in Q1 FY27 was 33.3%, primarily due to a change in product mix.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts expects material costs to typically range between 34% and 37% over the business cycle.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin was 66.6% of revenue from operations in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6%

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts reported an EBITDA margin of 24% for Q4 FY26 and 22% for full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management considers a 20% EBITDA margin to be sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs returned to normal expected levels of 34% to 37%, standing at 35% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: our material cost of 35% has now come back to where we've always said our normal material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%.

margins_costs.claim: The introduction of the new wage code in November 2025 caused an INR 3.4 crore impact on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Uniparts maintains a trailing 12-month new business order book of over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month new business wins exceeded INR 225 crores, growing over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: New business wins require balancing capex which keeps total capex within 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: What this means is that when we get a new business, then at that point in time, we only need to do balancing capex and hence, that capex remains in the range of 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts closed Q1 FY27 with a net cash balance of approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended quarter with net cash position of approximately INR190 crores, underlining the strength of our cash generation capabilities and financial discipline.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow generated during Q1 FY27 was INR 44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is evaluating about half a dozen acquisition targets in hydraulics, PTOs, and fabrications.
capital_allocation.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: A special dividend of INR 101 crore was declared in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Management continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts remains net debt free with net cash of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividend distributed for FY26 reached INR 170 crores, including a special dividend of INR 101 crores declared in Q3 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts has evaluated around a dozen acquisition targets since its IPO and looks for targets that add a third platform and are ROE and ROCE accretive.
capital_allocation.quote: Internally, at Uniparts, when we are looking at an acquisition, we have a clear framework where the target must add meaningful third platform. It should be manageable in size, and it should be ROE and ROCE accretive, right?

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has created pressure on supply chains and input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility previously led customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing in the aftermarket.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases in Western markets has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred in the finishing shop of the Ludhiana facility towards the end of Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: Increasing input prices due to geopolitical situations are being partially mitigated by favorable exchange rates.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of this inflation is being mitigated by favourable exchange rates.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful contributor within 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 revenue growth to be in line with the growth delivered in FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company is making efforts to rebuild the fire-affected Ludhiana plant and bring it back online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to keeping capex unchanged at 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
